dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting from apex to posterior base, interrupted by a distinct V-shaped notch on the lower third of the trailing margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate convex slope rising from the anterior dorsal ridge relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum horizontal base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a large radius forming a prominent rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick pixel length relative to the head size, extending horizontally from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly visible obtuse angle forming a distinct indentation where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch-like indentation on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin; several small dark circular spots visible on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct tripartite pigmentation pattern featuring a dark dorsal cape, lighter flanks, and a prominent dark patch on the lower mid-body.
